create_feature_extractor_model: create a FeatureExtractorModel instance with a model config to extract features from a base trunk model
run_feature_extractor_forward: run the feature extractor forward pass on a batch with specified output feature keys
freeze_feature_extractor_model: freeze all parameters of the feature extractor base model to prevent gradient updates
attach_feature_pool_layers: attach pooling operations like AdaptiveAvgPool2d or MaxPool2d to extract pooled features
override_feature_extractor_train_mode: override train mode to keep base model in eval while setting children training mode
